changes: In /agent/solver.md I added a hard submission gate (step 7) and a cost-definition check (step 8). The gate requires a passing run_tests on the public examples and a timing run under about 1 s at max size before submit, and says a timeout is not excused by explaining its cause. The failures showed that several runs submitted untested drafts (lcb-3655 had 0 test runs) and that the TLE runs were submitted after timed-out timing checks. The step-8 cost-definition check targets the wrong-answer cases where the cost model was misread. One trial on lcb-3655 still failed: the agent did run the public examples this time, but then submitted after a timeout without re-timing or brute-force checking, which is the behaviour the new wording now forbids. I did not re-trial after the final wording change, so its effect is unverified.
